description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Big Mother Mouser with haste. It enters with two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Big Mother Mouser token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Big Mother Mouser token dies, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Robot artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Robots, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
